threat_event: Ransomware that starts in business IT spreads through the IT/OT firewall and encrypts SCADA servers and HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad IT/OT firewall rules including remote desktop to HMIs; dual-homed engineering workstation; no OT DMZ; EDR alerts unwatched after hours
existing_controls: MFA on VPN and email; EDR on corporate endpoints; IT/OT firewall exists
treatment_plan: Build an OT DMZ with the historian replica as the only crossing point; remove remote desktop from corporate to HMIs; retire the dual-homed workstation; 24x7 managed detection and response for EDR

threat_event: Attacker uses the SCADA integrator's always-on remote access tool to operate HMIs and change setpoints
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist using stolen vendor credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared vendor account; no MFA; no session logging; tool always running on the SCADA primary server
existing_controls: Hardwired safety shutdowns limit physical consequences
treatment_plan: Remove the always-on tool; vendor access only through a jump host with named accounts, MFA, session recording, and approval per session

threat_event: SCADA backups and cloud backups are encrypted or deleted along with production, so SCADA cannot be rebuilt
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA backup device in the same room and domain as the servers; PLC and RTU programs not backed up centrally; cloud backups in the production account; no restore test
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-04 backup vault; BP-01; BP-02; BP-03
existing_controls: Nightly SCADA backup to local storage; daily cloud snapshots
treatment_plan: Weekly offline copy of SCADA images and controller programs; separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; quarterly restore test on a spare server

threat_event: Attacker in the radio network sends spoofed commands to well-pad RTUs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy 900 MHz radio protocol with no message authentication or encryption
existing_controls: Radio network licensed; hardwired safety shutdowns
treatment_plan: Accept for now; require authenticated radios at the next radio refresh (2028) and add radio traffic to OT monitoring

threat_event: Exploit of a known vulnerability in the unsupported SCADA server and HMI operating system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past end of vendor support; no OT vulnerability management
existing_controls: Behind IT/OT firewall
treatment_plan: Upgrade SCADA servers and HMIs to a supported OS with the integrator (vendor-qualified version); OT vulnerability tracking against advisories

threat_event: Unapproved PLC or RTU logic change alters an injection pressure limit or shutdown setting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change management or version control for controller programs; no second-person review
existing_controls: Experienced technicians; hardwired high-pressure shutdowns
treatment_plan: Change request and peer review for every logic change; program version repository; compare running logic to baseline quarterly

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a royalty owner or vendor payment to an attacker's bank account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes verified only by email; no training on payment fraud
existing_controls: MFA on email; dual approval of payment runs
treatment_plan: Call-back verification to a known number for any bank change; payment fraud training for accounting staff; external email tagging

threat_event: Royalty owner personal information (names with Social Security numbers) is stolen from production accounting exports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner exports saved to the shared file area and emailed to the outside tax preparer without encryption
existing_controls: MFA on the SaaS and email
treatment_plan: Stop exports to the shared area; deliver 1099 files through the vendor's secure transfer; data loss prevention rule for Social Security numbers

threat_event: Departing employee copies seismic interpretations and reservoir models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reservoir files in a shared area open to all staff; no download alerts
existing_controls: Confidentiality clause in employment agreement
treatment_plan: Restrict reservoir data to the geoscience group; alert on bulk downloads; exit interview reminder

threat_event: Former employee or contractor uses access that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Access removal takes up to 7 days for field staff and contractors; no access review
existing_controls: HR emails IT at termination
treatment_plan: Same-day disable from the HR termination ticket; quarterly access reviews including SCADA local accounts

threat_event: A harmful command from an HMI cannot be traced to a person because of the shared operator login
threat_source: Production Controller or unauthorized person at the OCC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator login on OCC HMIs; no compensating controls
existing_controls: Badge access to the OCC; shift log
treatment_plan: Named HMI accounts where the SCADA software supports fast user switching; otherwise shift sign-in log tied to badge records (documented compensating control)

threat_event: A known-exploited vulnerability in field controller or modem firmware stays unpatched because the device is not known
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT asset inventory with models and firmware versions
existing_controls: Integrator keeps partial drawings
treatment_plan: Build the OT asset inventory from passive monitoring and site visits; check it monthly against CISA ICS advisories

threat_event: Intrusion into the SCADA network goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT network monitoring; SCADA server logs not collected
existing_controls: None in OT
treatment_plan: Passive OT network monitoring sensor at the OCC; forward SCADA server and firewall logs to the monitoring service

threat_event: Hurricane, fire, or flood at the OCC disables both SCADA servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary and standby SCADA servers in one room at the Panhandle field office
existing_controls: Generator at the OCC; hurricane shut-in procedure
treatment_plan: Move the standby SCADA server to the South Florida field office server closet; test failover twice a year

threat_event: Hurricane causes a multi-day loss of power and communications to field sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field sites on utility power; radio towers and cellular sites exposed
existing_controls: Pre-storm shut-in procedure in the emergency response plan
treatment_plan: Accept; the pre-storm shut-in procedure controls the safety and environmental impact

threat_event: Cellular carrier outage cuts off view of the South Florida sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single carrier for all cellular modems
existing_controls: Manual route coverage by lease operators
treatment_plan: Accept; review dual-carrier modems at the next modem refresh

threat_event: Production accounting SaaS outage at month-end delays royalty payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS provider; no offline export of the owner deck
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability commitments (RTO 24 h)
treatment_plan: Accept; keep a monthly encrypted export of the owner deck and payment history

threat_event: Breach at the production accounting vendor exposes royalty owner personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds Social Security numbers of about 2,300 owners; contract lacks a breach notice deadline
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed annually
treatment_plan: Add a breach notice clause at renewal (the statute already requires notice within 10 days of determination); annual SOC 2 review (P09)

threat_event: Compromised SCADA software update or integrator laptop introduces malware into the SCADA network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No verification of update files; integrator laptops not checked before connecting
existing_controls: Integrator is a long-standing supplier
treatment_plan: Verify update hashes from the vendor portal; scan transient devices at a kiosk before connecting; security terms in the integrator contract

threat_event: Lost or stolen rugged tablet gives access to the field data capture app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets left in unattended trucks at well pads
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 tablets; SYS-04 field data capture app
existing_controls: Mobile device management with remote wipe; tablet encryption
treatment_plan: Accept; MDM wipe and app sign-in with MFA already reduce it

threat_event: Infected USB drive or technician laptop spreads malware to HMIs and engineering workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB ports open on HMIs; no transient device scanning
existing_controls: Antivirus on HMIs (signature updates monthly)
treatment_plan: Block USB storage on HMIs; scanning kiosk at the OCC; company-owned maintenance laptops only

threat_event: Insider falsifies run tickets or allocations to hide theft of crude
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Run tickets editable after submission; no reconciliation to SCADA tank levels
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 field data capture app; SYS-03
existing_controls: Purchaser gauger co-signs tickets
treatment_plan: Lock tickets after submission; monthly reconciliation of tickets to SCADA tank levels

threat_event: Tampering with an RTU cabinet at an unmanned well pad
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote pads with padlocked cabinets; no cabinet door alarms
existing_controls: Fenced and locked pads; lease operator visits
treatment_plan: Accept; add cabinet door switches to SCADA alarms when cabinets are replaced

threat_event: Stolen cloud administrator credential used to encrypt or delete cloud workloads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup administration not separated from production administration
existing_controls: MFA on the cloud console
treatment_plan: Separate backup account and roles (see R-003); phishing-resistant MFA for cloud administrators

threat_event: Malware on corporate endpoints goes unanswered overnight because EDR alerts are watched only in business hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No after-hours alert monitoring
existing_controls: EDR on corporate endpoints
treatment_plan: 24x7 managed detection and response service for EDR with authority to isolate hosts

threat_event: Uncoordinated response during a cyber incident: fields shut in unnecessarily or SCADA left connected too long
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT incident response plan; no tabletop; manual-operations procedure not linked to cyber events
existing_controls: Emergency response plan for spills and H2S
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; joint IT and operations tabletop; decision table for isolating the SCADA network

threat_event: Employee personal information or vehicle location history exposed by the HR or telematics vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendors hold Social Security numbers and geolocation; contracts lack breach notice terms
existing_controls: Vendor MFA; SSO for HR SaaS
treatment_plan: Add breach notice and security terms at renewal; collect SOC 2 reports

threat_event: Predictive maintenance model misses a pump failure or floods crews with false alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot model trained on 3 years of Panhandle data; South Florida wells underrepresented
existing_controls: Engineer reviews every alert before a work order
treatment_plan: AI risk assessment controls in P10: performance thresholds by area and lift type; monthly review

threat_event: Staff paste confidential reservoir or royalty data into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; no AI rules in policy
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list and POL-05 rules; enterprise AI tool with data protections

threat_event: Only one person can rebuild the SCADA configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA and Automation Supervisor holds most configuration knowledge; documentation incomplete
existing_controls: Integrator support contract
treatment_plan: Document the SCADA build and restore steps; cross-train two automation technicians

threat_event: Cyber insurance claim is disputed because vendor remote access lacked the MFA the policy requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared vendor account without MFA on the SCADA server (R-002)
existing_controls: MFA on all company-user remote access
treatment_plan: Close R-002; confirm remediation to the carrier in writing at renewal

threat_event: Internet scan finds a well-pad cellular modem with a default admin password and reaches the RTU behind it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 modems on a public mobile network with web management reachable from the internet and default passwords (P07 finding)
existing_controls: None on these 3 modems
treatment_plan: Move the 3 modems to the private network; change all modem passwords; disable internet-facing management on every modem
